ground_truth.label: constructed
ground_truth.meaning: labels are true by construction of a seeded generator; suitable for calibration stress testing, not evidence of real-world accuracy
purpose: generalisation to templates never seen in development
caveats: email categories are synthetic: 80 seeded templates (half English, half German) with item, company, sender, city, country, date and number fills, not real mail
the label is the template's category by design; no human checked it

1000 rows, no two with the same text (case and whitespace ignored), but rows of one template differ only in their fills: near-duplicates by design; only the template-level split in examples/email-routing-v2/split-templates.json (20 of 80 templates held out) measures generalisation
100 % here is the floor a judge must clear, not evidence of production routing accuracy
